item.title: Correction · Pier 70 Parcel E2 (block): The 2026-10-06 entry for this record said the 2042 date…
item.description: The 2026-10-06 entry for this record said the 2042 date comes from the Development Agreement's Schedule of Performance. That was wrong. The Port's 2017 staff report (Item 9B, p.7) puts the Schedule of Performance in the Disposition and Development Agreement (DDA) between the Port and the developer, which is a different agreement from the Development Agreement between the City and the developer. The report says the developer must complete phase 3 within approximately 25 years of project approval, but it never states the year 2042; 2042 is Pier & Point's own arithmetic (2017 plus 25 years). It stays labelled a legal outside date, not an expected completion. Source: https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/Item%209B%20Pier%2070%20Approval%20092217.pdf.

item.title: Correction · Pier 70 Parcel E2 (block): We corrected the E2 page: the Port's 2026 proposal asks…
item.description: We corrected the E2 page: the Port's 2026 proposal asks the developer to elect to exercise its option on E2 first, which is not the same as closing on the parcel; no source says the proposed 90-foot heights apply to E2; and E2 sits across Maryland Street from Building 12, not south of it. Source: Port Commission minutes, 2017-09-26 (sfport.com/media/2994/download?inline); The Real Deal, 2022-04-27 (therealdeal.com/san-francisco/2022/04/27/brookfield-pauses-3-5b-mixed-use-project-on-pier-70/); Bisnow, 2022-10-20 (bisnow.com/san-francisco/news/mixed-use/brookfield-properties-and-port-of-san-francisco-inch-closer-to-pier-70-completion-115959); Port Item 11A staff report, 2026-08-07 (sfport.com/sites/default/files/2026-08/item_11a_p70_project_update_-_term_sheet_overview_-_information.pdf); Port Item 12B memo, 2020-02-07, and Port Commission minutes, 2020-02-25 (sfport.com/media/5772/download?inline); Ordinance 224-17 (sfbos.org/sites/default/files/o0224-17.pdf); Port Item 9B staff report, 2017-09-22 (sfport.com/sites/default/files/Item%209B%20Pier%2070%20Approval%20092217.pdf); Pier 70 D4D, 2022-04-26, Figure 6.4.2 p.155 (sfport.com/media/8123/download?inline); SF Planning, Pier 70 project page (sfplanning.org/project/pier-70).
item.source: Port Commission minutes, 2017-09-26 (sfport.com/media/2994/download?inline); The Real Deal, 2022-04-27 (therealdeal.com/san-francisco/2022/04/27/brookfield-pauses-3-5b-mixed-use-project-on-pier-70/); Bisnow, 2022-10-20 (bisnow.com/san-francisco/news/mixed-use/brookfield-properties-and-port-of-san-francisco-inch-closer-to-pier-70-completion-115959); Port Item 11A staff report, 2026-08-07 (sfport.com/sites/default/files/2026-08/item_11a_p70_project_update_-_term_sheet_overview_-_information.pdf); Port Item 12B memo, 2020-02-07, and Port Commission minutes, 2020-02-25 (sfport.com/media/5772/download?inline); Ordinance 224-17 (sfbos.org/sites/default/files/o0224-17.pdf); Port Item 9B staff report, 2017-09-22 (sfport.com/sites/default/files/Item%209B%20Pier%2070%20Approval%20092217.pdf); Pier 70 D4D, 2022-04-26, Figure 6.4.2 p.155 (sfport.com/media/8123/download?inline); SF Planning, Pier 70 project page (sfplanning.org/project/pier-70)

item.title: Correction · Pier 70 Parcel E2 (block): The 2042 date on this record was drawn as an expected…
item.description: The 2042 date on this record was drawn as an expected completion. The Port's 2017 staff report calls it an outside date in the Development Agreement's Schedule of Performance (Phase 3 within approximately 25 years of approval), not a construction schedule. It is now labelled a legal deadline and no longer moves this record's status on the map or the timeline. Source: https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/Item%209B%20Pier%2070%20Approval%20092217.pdf.

item.title: Correction · Pier 70 Parcel E2 (block): The map notes now say Parcel E2 has its own Assessor lot…
item.description: The map notes now say Parcel E2 has its own Assessor lot (Block 4116, Lot 008, per Port Item 12B) and no longer claim the site was never subdivided or that there may be two different 'E2' parcels. The 2042 completion milestone is a soft placeholder (the 2017 Phase 3 outside date, tolled by down market delay), and the claim that the Phase 1 schedule had lapsed was removed. The Item 11A milestones are dated to the Aug 7, 2026 staff report, 'since 2022' was dropped, the Board of Supervisors' Oct 31 and Nov 14, 2017 votes are stated correctly, and the design is credited to Kennerly only as a 2021 SF YIMBY report. The earlier entry for the Parcel E2 lease agenda item now reads 'enter into' rather than 'negotiate'. Source: Port of San Francisco, Commission Item 12B and Resolution 20-07, 2020-02-11 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/Documents/Item%2012B%20Pier%2070%20Parcels%20E2%20and%20A.pdf); Port of San Francisco, Commission Item 11A staff report, 2026-08-07 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2026-08/item_11a_p70_project_update_-_term_sheet_overview_-_information.pdf); Port of San Francisco, Commission Item 9B staff report, 2017-09-22 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/Item%209B%20Pier%2070%20Approval%20092217.pdf); San Francisco Board of Supervisors, Ordinance No. 224-17 (https://sfbos.org/sites/default/files/o0224-17.pdf); SF YIMBY, 2021-07-26 (https://sfyimby.com/pier-70-parcel-e2-design-by-kennerly-architecture-and-planning); Port Commission agenda, 2020-02-25 (https://sanfrancisco.granicus.com/AgendaViewer.php?view_id=92&clip_id=35274).

item.title: Milestone · Pier 70 Parcel E2 (block): Port staff report (memo dated Aug 7, 2026)… (Aug 7, 2026)
item.description: Port staff report (memo dated Aug 7, 2026) for the Aug 11, 2026 Port Commission meeting (informational item 11A) describes proposed DDA amendments: parcel-specific outside dates, a Project-wide affordable rate of no less than 20% (327 stand-alone affordable units kept), 65-to-90 ft height increases on certain residential parcels, developer return cut from 18% to 14%, and a new phasing plan (Aug 7, 2026). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-07; Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-11.
item.source: Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-07; Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-11

item.title: Planned · Pier 70 Parcel E2 (block): Port reports that although Phase 1 horizontal… (Aug 7, 2026)
item.description: Port reports that although Phase 1 horizontal infrastructure and Building 12's rehabilitation are complete, construction of Phase 1 vertical buildings and parks 'has not moved forward' because of pandemic-driven office-vacancy increases, 20-30% construction-cost escalation and higher financing costs (Aug 7, 2026). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-07.

item.title: Expected · Pier 70 Parcel E2 (block): Port Commission: Port staff and the developer… (~Dec 2026)
item.description: Port Commission: Port staff and the developer are drafting amendments to the DDA and related transaction documents "for consideration by the Port Commission and Board of Supervisors by the end of this year or early next year" (Item 11A, memo of Aug 7, 2026, p.2 and p.6). The source gives no hearing date. The date shown is the early end of that window (December 2026); "early next year" falls in 2027. The same report proposes extending the term of the DDA, Development Agreement and Master Lease by 5 years. (~Dec 2026). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-07.

item.title: Expected · Pier 70 Parcel E2 (block): Then the Board of Supervisors: the same… (~Dec 2026)
item.description: Then the Board of Supervisors: the same amendments are to go to the Board of Supervisors in the same window (Item 11A, p.6: "for consideration by the Port Commission and Board of Supervisors by the end of this year or early next year"). The source gives no separate date or order for the Board. The date shown is the early end of the window; "early next year" falls in 2027. (~Dec 2026). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-07.

item.title: Expected · Pier 70 Parcel E2 (block): The Phase 1 down market delay, which tolls… (Dec 26, 2026)
item.description: The Phase 1 down market delay, which tolls the developer's time-sensitive DDA obligations including close of escrow on option parcels, is extended to December 26, 2026: it reached its 60-month maximum in June 2026 and the parties agreed to extend it six months to allow time to complete the DDA amendments (Item 11A, memo of Aug 7, 2026, p.4: "the parties mutually agreed to extend the down market delay for an additional six months to December 26, 2026"). This is the end date of an extension the parties agreed under the DDA; the report does not call it a deadline, and it is not a forecast. (Dec 26, 2026). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-07.

item.title: Expected · Pier 70 Parcel E2 (block): No completion date is sourced for this parcel: its… (~2042)
item.description: No completion date is sourced for this parcel: its Phase 1 schedule is tolled and vertical construction has not moved forward. The 2017 DDA's Schedule of Performance sets outside dates for each phase's horizontal improvements and related public benefits, not for completing buildings; the nearer bounds that apply to this Phase 1 parcel (Phase 1 within 7.5 years after Project approval, and close of escrow on option parcels no later than three years after the Phase 1 horizontal improvements, excluding parks) are tolled by down market delay. 2042, the DDA's whole-project Phase 3 outside date (about 2042), is shown here only as the farthest outer bound, a soft placeholder (~2042). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2017-09-22; Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-07.
item.source: Port of San Francisco, 2017-09-22; Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-07

item.title: Milestone · Pier 70 Parcel E2 (block): Brookfield halts construction on the 28-Acre… (~Apr 2022)
item.description: Brookfield halts construction on the 28-Acre Site: The Real Deal (Apr 27, 2022, citing the San Francisco Business Times) reports 'Brookfield has halted construction' because of economic conditions, and Bisnow (Oct 20, 2022) reports that after the first phase's infrastructure and roadwork were completed 'progress stalled in April, with officials citing market conditions'. The Port's Aug 2026 report says the balance of Phase 1 horizontal work, largely the parks, is still to be built, so this was not the end of all Phase 1 horizontal work (~Apr 2022). Source: The Real Deal (citing San Francisco Business Times), 2022-04-27; Bisnow (Joseph Gordon), 2022-10-20; The Real Deal (citing SF Business Times), 2023-04-17; Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-07.

item.title: Milestone · Pier 70 Parcel E2 (block): Port Commission Resolution 20-07 authorizes… (~Feb 2020)
item.description: Port Commission Resolution 20-07 authorizes offering Brookfield a 99-year lease option on E2 at the appraised value of $5,000,000, below the $11,280,135 Down Market Threshold, in exchange for tying it to the Parcel A option and a faster Parcel A closing. Port documents give two adoption dates, February 11, 2020 (the certificate printed on the resolution) and February 25, 2020 (the Commission's minutes of that meeting), so only the month is shown; see open questions (~Feb 2020). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2020-02-07; Port of San Francisco / Port Commission, 2020-02-25.
item.source: Port of San Francisco, 2020-02-07; Port of San Francisco / Port Commission, 2020-02-25
